## Summary
- Allow `/orchestrate` on discussion targets and enable planner mode for discussion orchestration.
- Allow planner-selected `implement` from PR/discussion orchestration by creating a focused tracking issue, dispatching `agent-implement.yml` against that issue, and linking back to the original surface.
- Keep explicit `/implement` unchanged; this PR only wires the orchestrated path. Adds focused coverage for policy, preflight, and handoff behavior.

Supersedes #294 with a smaller focused implementation.
Closes #227

## Tests
- `npm --prefix .agent run build`
- `node --test .agent/dist/__tests__/handoff.test.js .agent/dist/__tests__/orchestrate-handoff-cli.test.js .agent/dist/__tests__/orchestrator-preflight-cli.test.js .agent/dist/__tests__/triage.test.js`
- YAML parse for `agent-router.yml` and `agent-orchestrator.yml`
- `git diff --check`

## Summary of PR/Issue
- PR #302 closes #227 by allowing `/orchestrate` on discussions and allowing planner-selected `implement` from PRs and discussions.
- For non-issue targets, the implementation creates a tracking issue first, then dispatches `agent-implement.yml` against that issue.
- The PR supersedes #294 with a smaller focused implementation.
- The core route/policy direction matches the requested minimal behavior, but the smaller replacement drops some idempotency hardening and deeper docs updates from final #294.

## Review
No BLOCKING issue is supported by the current artifacts, but three WARNING-level follow-ups remain. Both reviewer outputs are consistent: #302 is scoped and functionally close, but not yet as robust or documented as the final #294 implementation.

| Issue | Severity | Description |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Tracking issue reuse relies only on issue search | WARNING | The non-issue implement path checks only issue-body search for the tracking marker before creating a new issue, so search lag or misses can create duplicate tracking issues. |
| Discussion stop comments bypass duplicate checks | WARNING | The discussion stop path posts directly through `addDiscussionComment()` and returns before the issue/PR duplicate guard runs. |
| Canonical `.agent/docs` still describe old orchestration limits | WARNING | README and prompts were updated, but deeper `.agent/docs` still describe orchestrate as issue/PR-only and PR orchestration as review/fix-pr-only. |

## Progress
- The requester’s minimal behavior from #227 is implemented at the route, planner, handoff, workflow, prompt, and focused-test levels.
- Authorization and target-kind constraints passed the rubrics review.
- GitHub `check` is passing, and `git diff --check main...origin/pr-302` is clean.
- Existing inline comments and review threads were empty before mutation; posted one inline comment at `.agent/src/cli/orchestrate-handoff.ts:682`.
- No inline replies, comment minimizations, or thread resolutions were added.

## Issue Details
<details>
<summary>Tracking issue reuse relies only on issue search</summary>

**Cause:** [`ensureOrchestratedImplementationIssue()`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/e85ca5405d74d2f79b289c0b89dbf296400a4d24/.agent/src/cli/orchestrate-handoff.ts#L681) calls a helper that searches issue bodies for the tracking marker, while the PR/discussion link-back body has no marker fallback.

**Candidate solutions:** Add trusted link-back marker/comment lookup before issue creation, or reuse the shared implementation-tracking helper shape from final #294.

**Comments:** This was posted inline at line 682 because it is concrete, line-specific, and not already clearly covered in the PR conversation.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Discussion stop comments bypass duplicate checks</summary>

**Cause:** The discussion branch calls [`addDiscussionComment()`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/e85ca5405d74d2f79b289c0b89dbf296400a4d24/.agent/src/cli/orchestrate-handoff.ts#L1495) and returns before `hasMatchingOrchestrateStopComment()` can prevent duplicate stop comments.

**Candidate solutions:** Fetch trusted discussion comments and skip posting when the same stop marker/body already exists.

**Comments:** Existing rubrics feedback already clearly covers this point, so no duplicate inline was posted.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Canonical `.agent/docs` still describe old orchestration limits</summary>

**Cause:** [`agent-actions.md`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/e85ca5405d74d2f79b289c0b89dbf296400a4d24/.agent/docs/actions/agent-actions.md#L18), [`supported-workflows.md`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/e85ca5405d74d2f79b289c0b89dbf296400a4d24/.agent/docs/architecture/supported-workflows.md#L27), and [`agent-orchestrator.md`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/e85ca5405d74d2f79b289c0b89dbf296400a4d24/.agent/docs/technical-details/agent-orchestrator.md#L83) still describe the previous issue/PR-only and PR review/fix-pr-only behavior.

**Candidate solutions:** Update those docs to include discussion orchestration and PR/discussion `implement` handoffs through tracking issues.

</details>

## Recommended Next Step
FIX_PR: the remaining warnings are concrete branch changes and are safe for an automated fix-pr pass.

## Final Verdict
MINOR_ISSUES

Yes. At current PR head `d8f706d`, #302 implements both high-level functions.

1. **PR `/orchestrate` -> `implement`: yes.** The planner can choose `implement` for PR orchestration, and the runtime creates or reuses a tracking issue first, then dispatches `agent-implement.yml` against that issue. Evidence: planner policy in [`agent-orchestrator.md`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/d8f706d15ecb4688aca270d3aed71c20f286dece/.github/prompts/agent-orchestrator.md#L55-L61), handoff validation in [`handoff.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/d8f706d15ecb4688aca270d3aed71c20f286dece/.agent/src/handoff.ts#L615-L635), tracking issue creation/reuse in [`orchestrate-handoff.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/d8f706d15ecb4688aca270d3aed71c20f286dece/.agent/src/cli/orchestrate-handoff.ts#L722-L762), and dispatch to implement in [`orchestrate-handoff.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/d8f706d15ecb4688aca270d3aed71c20f286dece/.agent/src/cli/orchestrate-handoff.ts#L1970-L1979).

2. **Discussion `/orchestrate` -> new implementation issue: yes.** The router now allows `/orchestrate` on discussions, the planner can select only `implement` as a workflow handoff for discussions, and the runtime creates/reuses a tracking issue before dispatching implement. Evidence: discussion route allowance in [`agent-router.yml`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/d8f706d15ecb4688aca270d3aed71c20f286dece/.github/workflows/agent-router.yml#L745-L755), discussion planner policy in [`agent-orchestrator.md`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/d8f706d15ecb4688aca270d3aed71c20f286dece/.github/prompts/agent-orchestrator.md#L62-L65), discussion-only handoff constraint in [`handoff.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/d8f706d15ecb4688aca270d3aed71c20f286dece/.agent/src/handoff.ts#L637-L642), and discussion metadata/link-back support in [`orchestrate-handoff.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/d8f706d15ecb4688aca270d3aed71c20f286dece/.agent/src/cli/orchestrate-handoff.ts#L515-L579).

Important nuance: for **issues**, orchestrated `implement` can run against the current issue. For **PRs and discussions**, this PR intentionally normalizes implementation through a separate tracking issue first, then runs `agent-implement.yml` on that issue. Current tests cover both PR and discussion tracking-issue flows.
